purpose: Adaptive development with a different local model package on two already-exposed cases; not learned-controller improvement or independent validation
policy: fixed sequential loop with failed-edit recovery; learned controller disabled
rules: Use issue text and base tracked source only; no reference/evaluator patches or solution links.
Keep failed attempts and do not extend the budget after seeing results.
Run official scoring only after each frozen prediction.
Report retrieval time, total candidate wall time, model tokens/calls, and outcomes; no net-efficiency claim.
A fresh independent sample is required before stronger performance claims.
compatibility_precondition: One neutral JSON schema response via existing transport must pass before benchmark inference. Record any setup failure without outcome-driven retries.
